Extract a provenance-linked curve table from a measurement record

Source: R/batch-quantitation.R
measure_record_curves.Rd

measure_record_curves() joins the relational tables of a measure_record() into a recipe-ready tibble while retaining sample, injection, channel, curve, source-digest, and parsed source-row provenance. Curves are returned in their original order without sorting, resampling, or unit conversion.

Usage

measure_record_curves(record, channel_id = NULL)

Arguments

record

A measure_record() object.

channel_id

Optional single character string restricting output to one declared channel in record$channels.

Value

A tibble with one row per curve and columns sample_id, injection_id, curve_id, channel_id, channel_name, source_id, source_name, source_sha256, axis_name, axis_unit, value_name, value_unit, n_points, source_row_start, source_row_end, .measures, and .source_rows.

See also

measure_record(), read_measure_record_delim(), measure_quantify_batch()

Examples

curve <- new_measure_tbl(c(1, 2, 3), c(0.1, 0.5, 0.2))
rec <- measure_record(
  samples = tibble::tibble(sample_id = "S1"),
  injections = tibble::tibble(injection_id = "INJ-1", sample_id = "S1"),
  channels = tibble::tibble(channel_id = "uv254", channel_name = "UV 254 nm"),
  curves = tibble::tibble(
    curve_id = "C1",
    injection_id = "INJ-1",
    channel_id = "uv254",
    .measures = list(curve)
  )
)
measure_record_curves(rec)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 17
#>   sample_id injection_id curve_id channel_id channel_name source_id source_name
#>   <chr>     <chr>        <chr>    <chr>      <chr>        <chr>     <chr>      
#> 1 S1        INJ-1        C1       uv254      UV 254 nm    NA        NA         
#> # ℹ 10 more variables: source_sha256 <chr>, axis_name <chr>, axis_unit <chr>,
#> #   value_name <chr>, value_unit <chr>, n_points <int>, source_row_start <int>,
#> #   source_row_end <int>, .measures <meas>, .source_rows <list>
